assistedFix.title: Assisted correction
assistedFix.intro: SequrAI prepares instructions for your coding agent and verifies the commit you report. SequrAI does not change your code or write to GitHub.
assistedFix.empty: There are no proposals for this project yet.

note.proposal: Instructions for your agent. SequrAI has not changed your code or written to GitHub, and nothing has been verified yet.
note.approved: Approved. You still need to report the commit that contains the correction. Nothing has been verified yet.
note.applied: Commit reported. Pending verification: nothing has been verified yet.
note.verifying: Verifying the reported commit… This page updates by itself.
note.verified: Verified: a complete rescan of that commit does not contain the finding.
note.not_verified: This proposal is not verified. Do not treat it as fixed.
note.historical: Historical proposal: replaced by a later one.
note.updating: We are updating the evidence for this correction. We cannot say yet whether it is verified or has failed.

statement.exact_commit_rescan_clean: A complete rescan of exactly that commit no longer contains the finding.
statement.later_analysis_clean_unbound: A later analysis no longer contains the finding, but it is not tied to the commit you reported: it does not count as a verification of your commit.
statement.not_verified: The reported commit could not be verified.

notice.no_blockers: There are no blockers to generate a proposal for.
notice.reused: A proposal already existed for this finding and analysis: the existing one is shown, nothing was duplicated.

choose.title: Which problem do you want a proposal for?

commit.title: Report the correction commit
commit.label: Commit (full SHA)
commit.help: The field is never filled in for you. Enter the full SHA of the commit that contains your correction.

errors.not_full_sha: The SHA must be exactly 40 hexadecimal characters.
errors.same_as_base: That is the commit that originated the finding: it cannot contain the correction.

suggestion.title: Suggestion: latest detected commit
suggestion.notice: This is only a suggestion: it has not been selected. Review it and confirm it yourself.
suggestion.selectedHint: The field was filled with the suggestion. Review it and press “Review”: nothing has been sent.

confirm.branchUnknown: not determined (no analysis of this commit yet)
confirm.noAnalysisWarning: There is no analysis of this commit yet. Verification may stay “not verified” until SequrAI analyzes it (it happens when the branch is pushed).
confirm.statement: You are declaring that commit {sha} contains the correction for “{title}”. SequrAI will rescan it; until then it is not verified.
confirm.invalidatesApproval: A commit was already reported ({previous}). Reporting {sha} invalidates the approval: after confirming you will need to approve the proposal again before it can be verified.

errors.not_found: We could not find this correction in your workspace. Reload the page.
errors.open_fix_exists: There is already an open correction for this finding. Continue with that one.
errors.in_flight: There is already a correction in progress for this finding on another analysis. Finish or reopen it before generating another.
errors.invalid_state: That action is not available in the correction's current state. The state was reloaded; try again if it applies.
errors.commit_is_base: That is the commit that originated the finding: it cannot contain the correction.
errors.commit_locked: This correction's commit is already fixed and cannot change in this state. Reopen it to report another commit.
errors.commit_conflict: That commit is already associated with another correction.
errors.unsupported: This installation does not support reporting a commit yet. Try again later.
errors.invalid_commit: The submitted data is not valid. Check the SHA.
errors.unavailable: We could not complete the operation and nothing was changed. Try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.unknown: Something failed. The state shown is the saved one; try again.

assistedFix.evidenceFailed: The evidence for this correction could not be updated. Its result cannot be stated yet: reload the page or retry.

notePrevious.proposal: Instructions for your agent. This proposal was reopened: the commit below is from an earlier attempt and is not verified. SequrAI has not changed your code.
notePrevious.approved: Approved. The commit below is from an earlier attempt and does not count. Report the commit that contains the fix. Nothing is verified yet.
